description: Joint Research Centre: wastewater datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Joint Research Centre, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Joint Research Centre. Coverage: Joint Research Centre. The listing groups 7 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about wastewater; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Waste water treatment; domestic waste water according to the Directive; Waste water treatment; industrial waste water according to the Directi; Waste water treatment; chemical reduction/oxidation process, municipal; Wastewater in-silico NGS dataset. Formats seen: ZIP, TAR_GZ, CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://eplca.jrc.ec.europa.eu/ELCD3/templates/default/html/datasetLicense.html), European Commission reuse notice, CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-jrc.
